subject: Film & Cinema
title: David Lynch: Dreams and Nightmares
description: Learn David Lynch: Dreams and Nightmares in one minute.

hook.text: Lynch makes films that feel like dreams you can't quite explain but can't stop thinking about.

buildup.text: Mulholland Drive, Blue Velvet, and Twin Peaks blend surrealism with American suburban horror.

discovery.text: He relies on intuition over logic — scenes are chosen for how they feel, not what they mean.

twist.text: Lynch turned down Star Wars: Return of the Jedi to make Dune. The gamble didn't pay off.

climax.text: His work proves that cinema doesn't need to be understood to be deeply felt.

punchline.text: The strangest films feel the most real.

quiz.question: What does Lynch prioritize in his filmmaking?
options: Intuitive emotional feeling over literal meaning
